plain.li: Someone showed me where the food is, where I sleep, and where they bury people. In that order. Practical folk.
[night] Can't sleep. Every noise outside sounds like something with too many legs. The others snore right through it.
[summer,hot] Walked in sunburnt and half dead from thirst. First thing they handed me was water. Second thing was a shovel.
[child] A grown-up here gave me a blanket and didn't ask me any questions. I'm keeping the blanket.
[old] Too old to be starting over. Did it anyway. My knees have filed a formal complaint.

warm.li: Someone saved me the last warm bowl and wouldn't hear a word about it. I'll learn their name tomorrow and thank them properly.
[skill:Cooking] I offered to cook tomorrow. The looks on their faces told me exactly how long they've been eating the same thing.

blunt.li: Nobody's tried to rob me yet. Low bar. They cleared it.
[large] Too many faces. I'll learn the useful ones' names first.

cheerful.li: I have a bed! An actual bed! Something lives under it, but we've reached an understanding!
[spring] Arrived on the first warm day of spring! Mud to the knees and little green shoots everywhere! I'm calling it a good omen!

gloomy.li: They seem decent. The last lot seemed decent too, right up until they didn't.
[rain,night] Rain on a roof that isn't mine. I keep waiting for someone to tell me to leave.

cold.li: Two of them are competent. One is a liability. The rest I haven't measured yet.
[poor] Thin stores, weak walls. They need me more than I need them. A useful position to start from.

plain.li: Found some blank pages and nothing to do with them. So: a journal. First entry. The roof leaks.
[child] This is my journal. If you are not me, stop reading. That means you.
[teen] The adults keep talking about where they came from like it's a real place. This journal is only for things that actually happen here.
[lowtech] Writing in charcoal on a scraped hide. My handwriting is worse than my cooking, and my cooking has made people sick.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Started a journal because it's the only hobby that can be done lying down.

warm.li: I want something to leave for whoever comes after. Proof that we were here, and we tried, and some days it went well.
[large] So many people here now. I'm writing down one good thing about each of them before I forget who did what.

blunt.li: First entry. Things I hate so far: the cold, the food, two of the people. Won't say which. Yet.
[doubtful] Starting this so there's a record of what the council says it'll do. Someone has to keep track.

cheerful.li: Page one! I drew the colony at the top. The drawing is nicer than the colony! Give it time!
[highmood] Started a journal because the day was so good I wanted to keep it somewhere safe!

gloomy.li: Keeping a journal is optimism, really. It assumes someone will be around to read it.
[storm] Thunder rattling the walls all night. Seemed like the right time to start writing things down, in case the roof goes.

cold.li: I'll record what each of them contributes. It will be useful when the time comes to decide who is necessary.
[spacer] Log started on a salvaged datapad. The previous owner had poor security and worse poetry. Both deleted.

plain.li: It's done: {WISH}. I keep catching myself smiling at nothing.
[repeat] Second time asking, and this time it stuck. Maybe I just needed to be more annoying.
[forother] I never even asked for this. Someone spoke up for me, and the council listened. I don't know what to do with that.
[child] The grown-ups said yes! I said thank you to everybody, even the ones who weren't there.
[poor] We have almost nothing and they still found a way. Guilty and grateful, both at once.

warm.li: I said thank you four times. Somebody finally told me to stop. So here's a fifth, where nobody can stop me.
[trusting] They keep doing right by me. I'm going to try very hard to deserve it.

blunt.li: Didn't even have to shout this time. Progress.
[trait:Greedy] Got it. Already thinking about what to ask for next.

cheerful.li: They said YES! I did a little dance in the storeroom and someone walked in! I regret nothing!
[cold] Freezing outside and I don't even care! They said yes! I'll feel my toes again tomorrow!

gloomy.li: They gave me what I wanted. Now I have something to lose.
[lowmood] Even this didn't lift me much. That's not their fault. I'm writing it down so I remember they tried.

cold.li: Request fulfilled: {WISH}. I now have a rough idea what my goodwill costs them.
[rich] They could afford it easily. I should have asked for more.

plain.li: They promised me "{WISH}" and here it is. I'd prepared a whole speech for when they forgot. Wasted.
[doubtful] I'd half written the angry entry already. Crossing it out. Neatly, for now.
[bitter] One kept promise doesn't fix everything. It fixes something. I'll take something.
[old] At my age you stop expecting people to keep their word. They kept it, and made an old fool of me. Gladly.
[teen] They actually did what they said they would. Adults. Who knew.

warm.li: A promise kept: {WISH}. I made sure to thank the ones who did the actual work, not just the ones who gave their word.
[winter] Bitter cold out, and they still kept their word. I'll remember that the next time someone grumbles about the council.

blunt.li: They kept their word. I'm shocked. Mildly. Don't tell them.
[hurt] Can barely stand, but they kept their word. Better than the medicine, and the medicine is terrible.

cheerful.li: They PROMISED and they DID IT! I'm going to bring it up at every meal for a week!
Promise kept, belly full, nobody shot at me! If tomorrow is half this good I might actually burst!

gloomy.li: They kept their word. Now I don't know what to do with all the disappointment I'd saved up.
[rain] Raining, naturally. But they kept their promise, so I'll let the rain off just this once.

cold.li: Promise honored on schedule. Now I know which of them can be relied upon, and which of them merely talk.
[skill:Social] Kept, as I expected. I'd made sure they knew I was counting the days. People perform better when someone is counting.

plain.li: So "{WISH}" just quietly died. No meeting, no answer. I didn't even get the dignity of a no.
[forother] It wasn't even for me. I asked on someone else's behalf, and they still couldn't be bothered.
[repeat] Same request, same silence. I could set the seasons by it.
[child] I asked the grown-ups and they forgot. I think grown-ups forget on purpose sometimes.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] Maybe I asked wrong. Too quiet, too loud, too often. I'll be up all night going over it.

warm.li: I'm not angry. I just wish someone had come by and said "not now". I'd have understood "not now".
[grieving] With everything that's happened lately, I can't blame them for forgetting. I only wish it hadn't been me they forgot.

blunt.li: Nobody did anything. Good to know where I stand. Somewhere behind the rice, apparently.
[doubtful] At this point I'd be more surprised if they'd actually done it.

cheerful.li: Didn't happen! Okay! I'll just sort it out myself somehow! How? Unclear! But somehow!
[fall] Didn't get it. But the leaves are turning and I refuse to be miserable in fall! I'll be miserable in winter, like a sensible person!

gloomy.li: Asked for "{WISH}". Got silence. Silence is the one thing this colony never runs short of.
[lowmood] I'm not even upset. I'd have had to expect something first.

cold.li: No answer within a reasonable time. I'll treat that as their real answer and plan around them.
[rich] Full storerooms, and still they couldn't manage it. A choice, then. Not a shortage.

plain.li: They promised me "{WISH}". Promised. I underlined the word so hard the page tore.
[trusting] I defended them when the others grumbled. I'll have to find something else to say now.
[night] Lying awake going over the conversation again. They said yes. I know they said yes.
[child] They PROMISED. A promise is a promise. Everybody knows that. Even little kids know that.
[old] I've lived long enough to know promises break. Apparently not long enough to stop believing them.

warm.li: I keep telling myself something must have come up. I just wish someone had come and told me what.
[skill:Social] I'll talk to them, calmly, tomorrow. Tonight I'm writing all the uncalm things down here, to get them out of me.

blunt.li: Promise broken. Next time they want me on the walls during a raid, I'll promise too.
I'm done giving them the benefit of the doubt. They used it all up.

cheerful.li: They broke it. I'm smiling at everyone anyway, because the alternative is screaming into the fields!
[trait:Sanguine] Promise broken. I've decided to forgive them by breakfast. Possibly lunch.

gloomy.li: I let myself believe it. That's the part I'm angriest about. Not them. Me.
[winter] Of course it was winter. Everything I ever hoped for died in a winter.

cold.li: I extended them credit. They defaulted. That won't happen twice.
[skill:Intellectual] I've written down exactly who said what, and when. Memory is unreliable. Paper isn't.

plain.li: Asked for "{WISH}". They said no and told me why. I hate that the reasons were good.
[repeat] Second no for the same thing. I'm starting to think it isn't the timing.
[forother] I asked for someone else and got a no. Now I have to go and tell them. That's worse than the no.
[teen] They said no like I'm a little kid. I'm not a little kid. I'm writing this very calmly.
[child] They said no. I asked why. They said "because". Because isn't a reason. Everybody knows that.

warm.li: They said no gently, and someone came by afterwards to see if I was all right. That helped more than I'll admit to them.
[trusting] If they said no, there's a reason. I'll trust that. I'll grumble a little first, then trust it.

blunt.li: They said no. Fine. I'll remember that the next time they need someone to haul in the rain.
No. Of course. The easiest word they know.

cheerful.li: A no! A real, honest, to-my-face no! Do you know how rare those are out here? I'm almost pleased! Almost!
[clear] They said no, but the sky was so clear tonight I couldn't stay sour! I tried! It lasted about an hour!

gloomy.li: No. Well, it was a long shot. Everything out here is a long shot.
[night] Lying in the dark rehearsing better ways I could have asked. None of them end in yes either.

cold.li: Refused, with reasons. Weak reasons, but reasons. I'll shape the next request so they can't use them.
[large] With this many mouths to please, they can't say yes to everyone. I simply assumed I'd be one of the exceptions.

plain.li: The council has gone with {DECREE}. I nodded through the whole announcement like it was my idea.
[trait:Industrious] Declared: {DECREE}. Work, and more of it. I could kiss whoever proposed it.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] They've declared {DECREE}. Less work for a while, if I play it right. I always play it right.
[bitter] Even a stopped clock. The council declared {DECREE}, and for once I can't argue. I tried.
[child] The grown-ups made a new rule: {DECREE}. I like this one. I don't like most rules.

warm.li: I think {DECREE} will do us good. I'll keep an eye on the ones who are struggling with it.
[large] With so many of us, it helps to have everyone pulling the same way. I'm glad they chose {DECREE}.

blunt.li: They declared {DECREE}. Anyone who wants to whine about it can whine to me.
One good decision. One. They're not off the hook.

cheerful.li: They declared {DECREE}! Exactly what I'd have done! I'm practically on the council!
[skill:Social] They declared {DECREE}, and I've already talked three people round to it! Two of them on purpose!

gloomy.li: The council declared {DECREE}. Right call. I'm waiting to find out what it costs us.
[lowmood] I agreed with something: {DECREE}. Felt strange. I'd forgotten how.

cold.li: The decision to impose {DECREE} was overdue. I've already noted who argued against it.
[trusting] Another sound decision from the council. They are becoming predictable. Predictable is useful.

plain.li: Declared: {DECREE}. I voted no in my head, very loudly.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] They declared {DECREE}. I'd planned a nap. I still plan a nap, but now I'll feel watched during it.
[trait:Wimp|trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] My hands haven't stopped shaking since they announced {DECREE}. I'm writing this very slowly.
[trait:Gourmand] The council declared {DECREE}. I ate my feelings at dinner. There weren't nearly enough of them.
[summer,hot] Hot as a kiln, and now {DECREE} on top of it. Somebody up there has never sweated in their life.

warm.li: I'll do my part under {DECREE}. I just wish someone had asked how the rest of us were holding up first.
[grieving] They declared {DECREE}. I haven't the heart to fight it right now. Ask me again when I've stopped crying at dinner.

blunt.li: The council declared {DECREE}. They're welcome to try making me enjoy it.
[bitter] They declared {DECREE}. Another thing done to us, not for us.

cheerful.li: They declared {DECREE}! I'm being very positive about it! Through my teeth, but positive!
Not even {DECREE} can ruin my week! It's trying! It's trying very hard!

gloomy.li: They declared {DECREE}. I'd say it can't get worse, but this place takes that as a dare.
[rain] Rain all day, and the council declared {DECREE}. The sky and I are in agreement.

cold.li: The council declared {DECREE} without consulting anyone competent. I expect to be consulted after it fails.
[skill:Intellectual] I've worked out what {DECREE} will cost us. I'll present the figures when it fails. They'll act surprised.

plain.li: Year {YEARS}. I went and stood where I first walked in. It's a wall now.
[old] {YEARS} year(s) here, and more of my life behind me than ahead. I'd rather spend what's left with this lot than anywhere else.
[child] I've been here {YEARS} year(s)! That's a really big part of my whole life! I worked it out with pebbles.
[grieving] Anniversary. I tried to count the people who were here when I arrived. I stopped partway through.
[winter] Snow on my anniversary. Spent it shoveling, which is about how I spent the first one.
[trait:Teetotaler] Someone offered me a drink for my anniversary. I had water and watched everyone else get sillier. Best show all year.

warm.li: I wrote down everyone who made this year bearable. It took two pages. I'll need a bigger journal.
[small] There are only a handful of us, and every one of them found me today to say something. That's the whole colony. I counted.

blunt.li: Year {YEARS}. Nobody's killed me yet. Not for lack of trying on the planet's part.
[hurt] Another year. Held together with stitches and spite, but here.

cheerful.li: Anniversary number {YEARS}! I made a mark on the doorframe! One every year until the doorframe's full!
[highmood] Anniversary, good mood, hot dinner! If you'd told me on day one it'd be like this, I'd have laughed! Then cried a bit!

gloomy.li: {YEARS} year(s) here. Longer than I've lasted anywhere. I don't trust it.
Somebody wished me a happy anniversary. I said thank you. I meant about half of it.

cold.li: I have now outlasted several colonists who were considered more valuable than me. Instructive.
[rich] The colony is worth far more now than when I arrived. A fair share of that is mine. I keep a list.

plain.li: Heard someone say "ask {TITLE}" in the next room. Took me a moment to realize they meant me.
[newcomer] I've barely been here long enough to learn everyone's names, and they've already given me one: {TITLE}.
[child] They call me {TITLE} now. Like a grown-up! I practiced saying it in a deep voice.
[teen] They call me {TITLE}. I acted like I didn't care. I've written it on the inside of my boot.
[skill:Artistic] Spent the evening carving {TITLE} into a scrap of wood. Sanded it off. Carved it again.

warm.li: They call me {TITLE}. Everything I know, I learned from people who aren't here to hear it. Some of them are buried out back.
They call me {TITLE}, and they mean it kindly. I'd do a lot for these people. Maybe that's why.

blunt.li: Being called {TITLE} doesn't come with extra rations. I checked.
[trait:Greedy] They call me {TITLE}. Lovely. A bigger room would be lovelier.

cheerful.li: Three people called me {TITLE} at dinner! THREE! I nearly choked on my food!
[skill:Social] I've introduced myself as {TITLE} to everyone. Some of them twice! They're thrilled! They're probably thrilled!

gloomy.li: So I'm {TITLE} now. Good. Then everyone will know who to blame when it goes wrong.
[lowmood] They call me {TITLE}. I wish I felt like it. I'll try to feel like it tomorrow.

cold.li: Being known as {TITLE} will make people defer to me. I intend to let them.
[large] In a colony this size, a reputation is a tool. Mine is {TITLE}. I'll keep it sharp.

plain.li: Someone yelled for {TITLE} across the yard and three people laughed. I laughed too, a bit late.
[child] Everyone calls me {TITLE} now. I asked what it means and the grown-ups looked at each other and went quiet.
[old] I had a perfectly good name for longer than most of them have been alive. Now I'm {TITLE}.
[hurt] They call me {TITLE}. I'd laugh, but laughing hurts right now. Most things do.
[trait:Ugly|trait:StaggeringlyUgly] They call me {TITLE}. Honestly, it's an improvement on what they used to whisper.

warm.li: They call me {TITLE}. Someone has to be, I suppose. Better me than someone who'd mind.
[small] With so few of us, everyone gets a nickname sooner or later. Mine is {TITLE}. I'm choosing to hear it as fondness.

blunt.li: Someone scratched {TITLE} into my bedframe. I know whose handwriting that is.
[trait:Brawler] They call me {TITLE}. From a safe distance, I notice.

cheerful.li: I'm {TITLE}! Not the name I'd have picked, but it's catchy and it's MINE!
They call me {TITLE} and I'm in too good a mood to care! I'll care tomorrow! Maybe!

gloomy.li: Of everything I've done here, that's what stuck: {TITLE}. A whole life summed up in a joke.
[lowmood] They call me {TITLE}. I can't even argue. They're not wrong, and I'm tired.

cold.li: Being known as {TITLE} lowers expectations. Low expectations are useful.
[bitter] They chose {TITLE} for me. I've chosen names for each of them, in here, where they can't see.

plain.li: I've started looking at everything like it's the last time. The ugly chair. The crooked wall. Even them.
[winter] Leaving in winter. Stupid, I know. Staying would be stupider.
[fall] Leaving with the harvest half in. Somebody else can bring it in. Somebody else can do a lot of things, now.
[trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] My hands won't stop shaking. I can't tell if it's leaving that scares me, or staying.
[grieving] Everyone I stayed for is in the ground out back. Nothing left to hold me here.

warm.li: I've said goodbye to the animals already. The people are harder. Some of them I'll actually miss.
[skill:Plants] Spent the evening in the fields. Somebody had better look after them properly when I'm gone.

blunt.li: Three days. If they want me to stay, they know what to say. They won't say it.
[trait:Greedy] I'm taking my share. I earned it. Every last scrap.

cheerful.li: I'm leaving! I keep telling myself it's an adventure! Out loud! At night! It's helping a little!
[spring] Leaving in spring! Flowers, sunshine, wild animals that want to eat me! An adventure!

gloomy.li: Told them I'm going. Now I'm waiting for someone to notice. It's a long wait, being noticed.
[rain] Rain, of course. Even the sky's seeing me off.

cold.li: I've worked out what I can carry and what I'm owed. The difference will be settled before I go.
[large] They won't miss one person in a colony this size. That was the problem all along.

plain.li: Spent the evening prying bits of someone's weapon out of my doorframe. The doorframe got off lightly.
[hurt] New scar. I'm told I was lucky. I saw what unlucky looked like today, so I believe it.
[winter,snow] Blood on snow is the brightest red there is. I'd rather not know that.
[fog] Fog so thick we heard them before we saw them. I'll be hearing them for a while yet.
[child] There was fighting and the grown-ups told me to hide and I hid. I was very good at hiding. I don't want to be good at it.
[teen] First real fight where they let me help. I thought I'd feel brave. Mostly I felt sick.

warm.li: Sat with the wounded until they fell asleep. Somebody has to, and holding a hand is something I'm good at.
[skill:Medicine] Stitched until my fingers cramped. Everyone I worked on is still breathing. Writing that down first, before anything else.

blunt.li: They came for our stuff. Most of them are our stuff now.
[trait:Bloodlust] Good day. Don't tell the others I said that.

cheerful.li: We're alive! I hugged three people who didn't want to be hugged! One of them hugged back!
[highmood] Honestly, good fight! Nobody I love got hurt, and one of them had a really nice hat!

gloomy.li: Washed someone else's blood out of my shirt tonight. It never fully comes out. Nothing here does.
[lowmood] During the fight I caught myself thinking: if I go now, at least I won't have to clean up after.

cold.li: Raiders arrive carrying weapons, clothing and perfectly good organs. We should be better at keeping them.
[skill:Shooting] I watched how each of them behaved under fire. I know now who I want beside me, and who I want in front.

plain.li: Walked past {OTHER_nameDef}'s spot at dinner three times before I remembered.
[night] Woke up and listened for {OTHER_nameDef}. Old habit. It'll take a while to break.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} isn't coming back. The grown-ups keep saying it in soft voices, like I didn't hear the first time.
[old] I've written too many of these. {OTHER_nameDef} goes under the others, and the page is nearly full.
[afterraid] They came, and {OTHER_nameDef} didn't walk away from it. I keep going over where I was standing.

warm.li: I kept something of {OTHER_nameDef}'s. I won't say what. It's under my pillow and it's staying there.
[spring] Everything's coming up green. {OTHER_nameDef} won't see it, so I'll look twice.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead and the work still needed doing. So I did it. Then I came here and wrote this.
[bitter] {OTHER_nameDef} is dead, and tomorrow the council will argue about chores like nothing happened.

cheerful.li: I told a story about {OTHER_nameDef} at dinner and everyone laughed. Then I went outside for a while and didn't.
[rain] {OTHER_nameDef} always liked the rain. I stood out in it for a bit, for both of us.

gloomy.li: They're digging a hole for {OTHER_nameDef}. They're getting quick at it. That's the part that frightens me.
[lowmood,afterraid] It should have been me. I don't mean that dramatically. I was standing closer.

cold.li: I've reassigned {OTHER_nameDef}'s work among the others. Then I sat in the empty room for longer than was necessary.
[trait:Psychopath] I'm told I should feel something about {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm writing this to find out if I do. Inconclusive.
